cases.result: A file whose header carries design conditions gives winter 99.6 % -2.5 °C and 99 % -1 °C, summer 0.4 % dry-bulb 39.8 °C and wet-bulb 21.8 °C; a file with none says so and the figures are worked out from the hours instead (bin/test-weather.mjs)
